Review the current IncidentWeaver change as if it were a pull request.

Read #file:../../AGENTS.md, #file:../copilot-instructions.md, the active issue, and its referenced ADRs.

Review for correctness, acceptance-criteria coverage, architecture drift, overengineering, provider/framework leakage, deterministic behavior, and test quality.
